beats.event: Huck, ward of Widow Douglas, chafes at civilized life
Abusive Pap imprisons him in a cabin
Huck stages his own murder and flees to Jackson's Island
Reunites with runaway slave Jim on the island
They raft down the Mississippi bound for free Cairo
Encounter a floating house with a dead man inside
Board a grounded steamboat crawling with thieves
Fog separates Huck from Jim on the river
Lands with Grangerfords, a family locked in blood feud
Feud erupts in slaughter; Huck escapes back to Jim
The King and Duke board the raft as con men
The con men run scams through river towns
Swindlers sell Jim to the Phelps family
Huck vows to rescue Jim, choosing friendship over 'sin'
Tom Sawyer arrives with an elaborate escape plan
Jim stays to help wounded Tom, is recaptured
Miss Watson's will has already set Jim free
Huck resolves to light out for the western territory
